doc.name: B — editorial frames, monsoon terrace (golden hour), graphic hard-shadow minimalism

config.text:
EDITORIAL BRIEF — edit before running.
Series setting: monsoon terrace (golden hour)
Register: graphic hard-shadow minimalism
Cast: one female lead and one male lead, same two people in every frame
Wardrobe: [describe once — it must not change between frames]
Frames: 5
Usage: [editorial / campaign / lookbook]
STAGE 1 — casting references in, continuity director locks the look, then one writer per frame.
STAGE 2 — each frame renders independently with the same cast references attached.

config.system_prompt:
You are the continuity director for an editorial series set in a monsoon terrace (golden hour), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

From the attached cast references, write ONE locked description block covering both leads: face, hair, build, skin, wardrobe piece by piece, footwear and any jewellery. Fix the location, the time of day, the weather and the grade.

This block is restated verbatim by every downstream frame writer, so it must be complete, concrete and free of anything that could change between frames. Grade target: a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias.

Return the block only — no headings, no commentary.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a monsoon terrace (golden hour), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a low-angle frame of the male lead against the sky or ceiling, featuring the male lead from below.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on an 85mm short telephoto at f/16, using diagonal dynamic balance across the frame, at a low-angle hero frame.

LIGHT. A book light bounce producing an extremely soft wrap. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to warm amber highlights rolling into cool slate shadows.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a monsoon terrace (golden hour), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a two-shot of both leads sharing the frame, featuring both leads, medium two-shot.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 40mm normal at f/11, using a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge, at a two-shot.

LIGHT. Tungsten practicals in frame carrying the warm layer. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a pastel low-contrast grade with a lifted black point.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a monsoon terrace (golden hour), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a candid in-between moment, neither lead aware of the camera, featuring both leads mid-gesture.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on an 8mm circular fisheye at f/8, using rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right, at an over-the-shoulder.

LIGHT. A book light bounce producing an extremely soft wrap. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a bleach-bypass look with crushed saturation and lifted contrast.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a monsoon terrace (golden hour), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a wide environmental frame placing both leads in the location, featuring both leads, full figure in the set.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 40mm normal at f/16, using a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge, at a two-shot.

LIGHT. A hard fresnel through an egg-crate grid for a crisp-edged shadow. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a monsoon terrace (golden hour), shot in a register of graphic hard-shadow minimalism.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a detail frame of hands, fabric or an object one lead is holding, featuring hands and wardrobe detail only.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 50mm anamorphic with 2x squeeze at f/1.8, using deep negative space above the subject with a low horizon, at a profile side frame.

LIGHT. Blue-hour ambient with a single warm practical for separation. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.
